newsitem.title: UK: Moody's affirms ratings of Lloyds TSB.
newsitem.headline: Moody's affirms ratings of Lloyds TSB.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday that it had confirmed the deposit, senior debt and financial strength ratings of Lloyds Bank Plc, TSB Bank Plc and of Cheltenham and Gloucester Plc.
"The Aa3 senior long-term debt rating and A1 subordinated debt rating of Lloyds TSB Group Plc, the ultimate holding company of the three banks, were also confirmed," Moody's said in a statement.

The deposit, senior debt and financial strength ratings of Lloyds Bank were affirmed at Aa2/Prime1/Bplus, of TSB Bank at Aa2/Prime1/Bplus, and of Cheltenham and Gloucester at Aa3/Prime1/B, Moody's said.

The confirmations followed the publication of the recommended proposal for Lloyds Abbey Life Plc, currently 62.4 percent-owned, to become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Lloyds TSB Group Plc, Moody's said.
Moody's said that proposal valued the 37.6 percent of Lloyds Abbey Life not already owned by Lloyds TSB at 1,675 million sterling.
"Under the terms of the proposal, the consideration is to be discharged by a combination of shares in Lloyds TSB Group plc and cash," it said.
The agency noted that the relative weighting of cash and shares will be partly dependent upon the choices made by the minority shareholders.
